purpose: Behavioral implementation guidance for Spreadsheet formula evaluation: arithmetic, comparison, text, percent and error results of the Calc interpreter.

requirements.statement: The input ScInterpreterContext reference becomes accessible via the constructed iterator's context interface
If an input table index is below zero or exceeds the document's last table index, that index is reset to the document's last table index
If an input row index is below zero or exceeds the document's last row index, that index is reset to the document's last row index
Returns zero when the sheet index derived from the third parameter does not correspond to an existing table
Returns zero when table metadata for the requested sheet index is null or uninitialized
Returns numerical zero when the column coordinate from the third argument is below zero
Returns numerical zero when the column coordinate meets or exceeds a derived upper column bound
Returns numerical zero when the row coordinate from the third argument is below zero
Returns numerical zero when the row coordinate meets or exceeds a derived upper row bound
The function returns 46 when the input convention type is zero
The function returns 36 when the input convention type is exactly one
The function returns zero for any input convention type that is neither zero nor one
Returns 1 if the default named range retrieved from the document has its lowest bit set in the status byte after necessary cleanup
Returns 1 if a named range matching the provided short identifier has its lowest bit set in the status byte after necessary cleanup
Pushes numeric 1.0 onto the interpreter stack when comparing equal finite double operands
Function evaluates a greater-than relation between two operands from the interpreter stack
If either operand is a matrix, the function prepares storage for a matrix-based evaluation context
Evaluates a less-than-or-equal comparison between the top two interpreter operands if they are convertible to numbers
The function configures for a subtraction operation then dispatches to a shared arithmetic handler
If the object's data end equals data start then a valid index between zero and a secondary limit returns a default item
The function computes a count based on the difference between two memory locations
Returns false for table indices greater than 9999
Returns true when table index is less than table count and corresponding registry entry is non-null
Returns zero flag value immediately when passed a document string with zero length field
Returns control without further processing after integrity checks if mode parameter equals three
Delegates to simplified single-component parser when mode is two or four passing first three input parameters adjusted
Searches input for first unquoted colon separator using external utility when mode is neither two nor three nor four
Produces separate substrings before and after colon delimiter for independent coordinate interpretation
Automatically swaps endpoint coordinates to ascending order per dimension when final positions violate canonical form
Combines validity flags from both parsed coordinate endpoints into final integer return value encoding success or failure modes
Sets the tab deleted flag when the flag input is nonzero
Clears the tab deleted flag when the flag input is zero
Preserves all other bits in the target field during modification
Adjusts the column index in the complex reference data based on input parameters and flags
Marks columns as deleted when the column index exceeds sheet limits or is negative
Adjusts the row index in the complex reference data based on input parameters and flags
Marks rows as deleted when the row index exceeds sheet limits or is negative

title: Cleanroom behavioral specification for Spreadsheet formula evaluation: arithmetic, comparison, text, percent and error results of the Calc interpreter
